title: Cloud & Data Strategy
summary: The future state cloud and data strategy focuses on migrating 65% of the estate to the cloud and resolving critical data fragmentation to enable real-time omnichannel operations.
narrative: The cloud strategy prioritizes a shift from on-premises data center concentration to a hybrid-cloud model, targeting a 65% migration rate to reduce legacy run-costs and increase release velocity.
Data strategy focuses on transitioning from batch-oriented interfaces to real-time eventing, specifically targeting the reduction of inventory sync latency from 360 minutes to 15 minutes.
Governance will evolve toward a shared data product ownership model to eliminate duplicate customer records and inconsistent SKU hierarchies across the commerce and supply-chain domains.

cards.title: Governance Model
cards.detail: Central data office with federated domain stewardship, but ownership enforcement is inconsistent across commerce and supply-chain domains.

callouts: Targeting a reduction in duplicate customer record rate from 11% to 3% through identity resolution.
Addressing batch-based inventory snapshots to eliminate stale availability signals for same-day fulfillment.
